'''Stella''' was one of the children of [[Resistance]] [[pilot]] [[Jaycris Tubbs]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> At the [[time]] of the [[Battle of D'Qar|Evacuation of D'Qar]]<ref name="Episode VIII">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> in [[34 ABY]],<ref>''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> Tubbs' [[flight helmet]] was inscribed with Stella's name, along with the names of Tubbs' other children, [[Ted]] and [[Phi]].<ref name="Episode VIII" />
